# Project Beta Proposal

Project Beta defines the requirements for a new ground segment for planetary missions. It runs from 2025 to 2027 and is coordinated by the Beta Systems Group.

## Work Plan

The work is split into three work packages.

### WP1: Stakeholder Survey

WP1 interviews mission operators about their current tools. WP1 runs in the first four months and delivers D1, the survey report.

### WP2: Requirements Consolidation

WP2 merges the survey results into one set of requirements. WP2 has 12 person-months and is led by the Beta Systems Group. WP2 delivers D2, the requirements document, in month 10.

### WP3: Data Processing

WP3 prototypes the processing part of the new ground segment. WP3 starts in month 8 and delivers D3, a prototype processor.

## Project Management

Project management in Project Beta is done by the coordinator alone, with a monthly call of all partners. Progress is reported to the funding agency once a year. There is no separate risk register; risks are discussed in the monthly call.
